name: bundled-provenance
argv:
import hashlib, importlib, pathlib, sys, sysconfig
print('executable', pathlib.Path(sys.executable).resolve())
print('version', sys.version.split()[0])
print('nousersite', int(sys.flags.no_user_site))
print('prefix', sys.prefix)
print('path0', sys.path[0] if sys.path else '')
usersite = sysconfig.get_path('purelib', scheme='nt_user') if sys.platform=='win32' else ''
print('usersite_scheme', usersite)
print('usersite_on_path', int(any(usersite and p.lower().startswith(str(usersite).lower()) for p in sys.path)))
for name in ('server','source_subscriptions','index','uoink_mcp','source_manifest','podcasts'):
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(name)
        path = pathlib.Path(getattr(mod, '__file__', '') or '')
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
        print('module', name, path.resolve() if path else None, digest)
    except Exception as exc:
        print('module', name, 'ERROR', type(exc).__name__, exc)
